description:
Local businesses near a US ZIP code or a town and state, such as '55401' or 'Duluth, MN': Shoptegrity's
    directory (co-ops, markets, credit unions; pilot areas) plus independent shops anywhere in the US (books,
    gifts, toys, food, markets, grocery, hardware, clothing, secondhand, outdoors, home, music), for Small
    Business Saturday or any local shopping. category narrows either list; radius_km is 0.1 to 500 (default 25;
    shops are searched within 15). Chains and franchises are left out. Not ranked by commission.
name: find_local_businesses
title: Find local businesses
